$comment: The agent's tools: JSON Schema for the arguments plus risk metadata the tool policy enforces at checkpoint 2a. Framework-neutral: every recipe builds its tools from this file.

tools.name: fetch_help_page
tools.description: Read a page of the shop's help centre. Use it for questions about shipping, returns or opening hours.

url.description: Page URL or topic, e.g. https://example.com/help/shipping

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up an order by its id (e.g. A1234) to answer questions about it. Returns the customer record, personal data included.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email. Only to the customer's own address or to the shop's domain.
